payload.text: A capacitor C initially at voltage V₀ discharges through resistance R at t=0.

parts.prompt: Predict how the observable changes when the defining scale parameter is doubled, and justify the prediction quantitatively.

criteria.description: Since τ=RC with C held fixed, doubling R doubles the time constant τ; the discharge takes twice as long to reach any given fraction of V₀, and the initial current magnitude V₀/R is halved.
